Visible here is a large stainless steel mixing bowl, probably about 28-30 cm across at the rim. The diced cooked chicken sits in a cluster roughly 9-10 cm wide. The pieces are about 1.5-2 cm each and mostly one layer deep, with a few stacked, so the pile is about 2 cm high.

Estimated volume is about 10 cm × 8 cm × 2 cm × a 0.5 packing factor, or roughly 80-100 cm³. Cooked chicken is about 1.05 g/cm³, which gives about 90 g. I counted roughly 45 pieces at about 2 g each, which also comes to about 90 g.
